product_one_liner.value: Sauce Labs provides a cloud-based testing platform for software development and quality teams to test web and mobile apps across real and virtual browsers, operating systems, and devices.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists pricing plans and prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in Sauce Labs case studies as organizations that selected or use Sauce Labs.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 331 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

founded_year.notes: Sauce Labs’ LinkedIn company profile reports 2008 as its founded year.

eng_blog.notes: The open-source blog includes infrastructure-as-code operations content and an engineering hackathon post about implementing a product UX improvement by front-end developers.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal contains multiple product guides and articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers board lists an AI Architect position, and the live posting describes AI/ML engineering responsibilities.

model_provider.value: Google Gemini AI and Vertex API (listed for the customer-support chatbot, natural-language data-query service, and data analysis).
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor disclosure names these services; it does not establish one model for every AI feature. Sauce Labs separately announced model choice for AURA enterprise customers.

compliance_certs.notes: Listed on the company security page; HIPAA and PCI DSS are not included because they are not named there.

last_funding.notes: The source gives the round date as 2024-01-26 and amount as USD 79,873,528.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent funding record is a Series G dated January 2024, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers board lists an Account Executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: Sauce Labs announced the ARM-native virtual Android testing cloud on September 29, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On April 16, 2026, Sauce Labs announced Steven Fitz as Chief Revenue Officer and Arun Lal as Senior Vice President of Global Marketing; both appointments fall within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Inside Sales Representative posting explicitly names both platforms.
